description: List the cities and areas Tubroom covers, with how many hotels with an in-room jacuzzi or hot tub each has and the tubroom.com list page. With no arguments returns totals per country and region; with a country or region returns its city lists.

country.description: Country to summarise by region (GB is the UK). Omit to cover all three.

region.description: A state, province or UK nation the user is interested in, by name or postal code ("Tennessee", "TN", "Ontario", "Scotland"). Returns its city lists instead of region totals.

name: list_places

credit.description: Attribution line to show with the answer.

places.description: City or area lists: name, region, country, hotels, newest check date, page.

updated.description: Newest check date on the list.

regions.description: Per region: name, code, country, number of lists and hotels.

lists.description: City or area lists in the region.

title: List places Tubroom covers
